devSplit.note: Identical to decision_tree.dev_split / knn.dev_split / regularization.dev_split: splits the outer-TRAINING partition (753 rows) into a fitting subset (n_fit=564) and a validation subset (n_val=189). The parameter-explorer activity (section 4) and section 6's model-selection step both use this exact reconstruction; the outer test set (251 rows, protocol.holdout_split) is touched only once, in section 6 step 6.
